note: Held-out real-text batch for German segment.inConstituents and segment.inMorphemes, round 6 of #1241, authored 2026-10-25 as Draft Breakdown Records in records/breakdown/de. Its 60 targets were sampled uniformly at random from the same frame as round 5's real-text batch (breakdown-heldout-2026-10-25-realtext, now promoted to tuning), with a new seed, and gold was authored only after sampling, so no target was replaced, skipped or reordered for being easy, hard or odd; rows RT1 to RT60 follow draw order. The frame is far from exhausted: of its 95,628 word tokens, 136 draws were judged. Two accepted draws were excluded after sampling as structural snags and replaced by the next accepted draws, 135 and 136 (see sampling): draw 24, eigentlich, whose epenthetic t (eigen-t-lich) no piece may show, and draw 125, traurig, whose traur drops an inner e of Trauer. A third, draw 30, her, was excluded on 2026-10-28, after the round was scored and promoted, with no replacement, so the batch holds 59 rows (RT14 is gone). The lab scores these records in segment-in-constituents/de:realtext, the round's headline set, and its bottom words in segment-in-morphemes/de:realtext. Gold: 34 of 59 have no Constituents: 21 declinable bottom words with a Root and an Ending (verbs kommen, wollen, reisen, sollen, dürfen, machen, schneien with en; nouns and adjectives Meile, Freude, Geschichte with e; Nacht, leicht, Bad, Kalauer, Haus, klein, Fürst, Kuckuck, Paket, Legat, Blut with ∅), 8 indeclinables with a Root and no Ending (desto, ei, gern, sondern, wieder, recht, sehr, anders), and 5 proper names with a Root and ∅ (Bottegone, Effi, Europa, Roswitha, Innstetten). 25 have Constituents: 8 derivations (richtig = richten + -ig, Verneigung, Wohnung, vertreiben, Verlegenheit, wirklich, Gewissen = ge- + wissen, Gesicht = ge- + Sicht), 7 compounds (Schaukelbrett, Schulvorsteherin, dienstfrei, Landrat, Veilchenwurzelluft, Blumenschale with the Interfix -n-, Nadelkissen), 5 particle verbs (gegenübersitzen, aufkommen, durchführen, zugeben, herantreten), 3 proper names (Thora von Penz = Thora · von · Penz; Güldenklee = gülden + Klee; Reeperbahn = Reep + -er- + Bahn) and 2 phrasemes (gefallen lassen, gnädige Frau). No target has a Source: a click unit with one is no segmenter case and was rejected at its draw. Every word split follows the DWDS Wortzerlegung, else the en.wiktionary etymology where DWDS gives none (Gewissen, Gesicht), and every bottom word is one neither splits (ADR 0050's tie rule), each cited in its record. Judged 2026-10-25 by two judges, system and learner POV (#1241), on 17 calls: they agreed on every other call and on both exclusions, and split on five rows, which carry contested and are reported apart from the headline until the user rules: anders, her, Gewissen, Gesicht and wirklich (the Kind only). The system judge also asked that the two excluded snags be logged as model gaps (an epenthetic t; an inner e dropped before -ig). None may be an example in a Breakdown prompt (#693). Promoted 2026-10-26 after round 6 scored them (#1241): every row is now dev, so the lab scores these records in segment-in-constituents/de:breakdown and their bottom words in segment-in-morphemes/de:breakdown, the sets prompts are tuned on, and round 7 is judged by a fresh real-text sample and a fresh adversarial batch. The user ruled on 2026-10-27 (#1241) that the dictionary decides split against no split, DWDS's Wortzerlegung, else en.wiktionary: Gewissen and Gesicht are now ge- + wissen and ge- + Sicht by en.wiktionary, anders the bottom word anders, as neither splits it, and the three are no longer contested. wirklich, a part-of-speech question, stays contested and is reported apart from the tuning score until the user rules. The user ruled on 2026-10-28 (#1241) that her in von den Dünen her is excluded: under the sampler's rule a token stands for its click unit, here the authored circumposition von … her, and authored grammar pieces get no Breakdown, so there is nothing to grade. It is a structural exclusion, as round 7's drüberhin, not a contested case: its row and record are gone, and it is scored in no set. They stay out of every Breakdown prompt's examples (#693).

sampling.frame: tf-demo Library's German Scrolls on 2026-10-25, as round 5 drew them: Effi Briest's 37 chapter Scrolls plus the Tagesschau article's German Sentences
sampling.tokens: Maximal letter runs in each Sentence, a run joined across an inner apostrophe kept whole (sich's)
sampling.prng: Python 3 random.Random(2026102506).shuffle over the frame's word-token indices, drawn in shuffled order
acceptance: A sampled token stands for its click unit: the biggest unit a click on it resolves to in context (Schlimmste in das Schlimmste is NOUN Schlimmste, not ADJ schlimm; the coordinator's ruling on round 5's draw 8, #1241)
That unit is a Lexeme, Locution or Saying tf-demo would ask a Breakdown for: not a closed route (AUX, DET, PRON, PART), not an Authored Inventory member, not Foreign

A token inside an authored grammar piece stands for that piece, an Authored Inventory member that gets no Breakdown, so its draw is excluded even when the token alone reads as a word: her in von den Dünen her is the circumposition von … her, an authored Locution ADP (adposition-cases.ts), not ADV her (the user's ruling of 2026-10-28 on round 6's draw 30, #1241)
It has no Source (ADR 0050): the host runs no segmenter on a conversion, a participle, a clipping or an acronym (a DWDS Grundform line names one)
The token is the unit's first member in the sentence, so each unit occurrence has one chance
Its Lemma is not already Breakdown gold
It is not a prompt word (#693)
Its Reading was not accepted before
